cases.case_label: De novo Alu in coding exon of NSD1
cases.mechanism_detail: De novo Alu inserted into a coding exon of NSD1, predicted loss of function; clinician deemed it likely causative and the patient's blood methylation profile clusters with Sotos syndrome cases.
cases.quote: Three out of four reported mutations (NSD1, MEF2C, and ARID2) were subsequently deemed to be likely causative of the patient’s phenotype (Supplementary Table 2) by the referring clinician.

cases.case_label: De novo L1 in coding exon of MEF2C
cases.mechanism_detail: De novo L1 inserted into a coding exon of MEF2C, a monoallelic DD gene, presumed loss of function; deemed likely causative by the referring clinician.
cases.quote: Three out of four reported mutations (NSD1, MEF2C, and ARID2) were subsequently deemed to be likely causative of the patient’s phenotype (Supplementary Table 2) by the referring clinician.

cases.case_label: De novo L1 in coding exon of ARID2
cases.mechanism_detail: De novo L1 inserted into a coding exon of ARID2 (probable monoallelic DD gene), presumed loss of function; deemed likely causative by the referring clinician.
cases.quote: Three out of four reported mutations (NSD1, MEF2C, and ARID2) were subsequently deemed to be likely causative of the patient’s phenotype (Supplementary Table 2) by the referring clinician.

cases.case_label: De novo paternal Alu in coding exon of SETD5
cases.disease: Developmental disorder (possible partial contribution; ciliopathy-like features)
cases.mechanism_detail: De novo Alu of paternal origin inserted into a coding exon of SETD5; because the patient's features suggest a ciliopathy, the authors consider it unlikely to be the sole cause but possibly contributing to a composite phenotype.
cases.quote: As such, the identified MEI is unlikely to be the sole cause for the patient’s DD, but may contribute to a composite phenotype.
